name: Eden Epstein
bio: Eden Epstein is an actress. She portrays the role of Wren, a Sighted member of the Trivantian Army who hides her gift from society. Epstein began appearing as Wren in the first episode of SEE's second season, "Brothers and Sisters".
place: New York City, New York, USA

credits.title: Behemoth!
credits.overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

credits.title: Listen
credits.overview: Dara Nevo, a young and dedicated soldier in the Israeli Defense Forces (IDF)'s elite intelligence unit, races against the clock to find an Israeli soldier captured in Gaza before her father's killer is released in a prisoner exchange.

credits.title: The Second Sun
credits.overview: Two lost souls meet one cold night in Post-war Manhattan. Before dawn deep rooted secrets will be revealed. And this man and woman, will believe in life, love, and most importantly miracles again. The human spirit can survive anything.

credits.title: Blind
credits.overview: A novelist is blinded in a car crash that killed his wife and several years later rediscovers his passion for life and writing when he embarks on an affair with the neglected wife of an indicted businessman.
